# JAG – Electrical Contractor

> JAG is a TDLR-licensed MEP contractor serving El Paso, Texas, and New Mexico with expertise in healthcare, industrial, and commercial electrical projects.

JAG specializes in mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) contracting services across Texas and New Mexico. The company holds minority business certifications including HUB, WOSB, MBE, and DBE designations, and maintains strong relationships with major clients in healthcare and industrial sectors.
